steps.print: (() => { const s = tre.activeVillage.state(); const h = s.entities.find((e) => e.id === 'hero'); const p = s.entities.find((e) => e.item?.kind === 'plank' && !e.item.held); h.hands.holds = p.id; p.item.held = 'hero'; p.hidden = true; return p.id; })()
